title: Your First Spring Boot Project
description: Generate a project using Spring Initializr.

slides.title: Spring Initializr 🎨
slides.content:
# The Project Starter

Go to [start.spring.io](https://start.spring.io) – this is your project factory.

**Pick these settings:**
* **Project**: Maven
* **Language**: Java
* **Spring Boot**: latest stable (e.g., 3.2.x)
* **Group**: com.example
* **Artifact**: demo
* **Dependencies**: **Spring Web** (click “Add”)

Then click **Generate** – you’ll get a ZIP file.

slides.title: Unzip and Open
slides.content: Unzip the file and open it in your IDE. In IntelliJ, choose **Open** and select the folder containing the `pom.xml` file.
slides.codeSnippet:
demo/
├── src/
│   ├── main/
│   │   ├── java/
│   │   │   └── com/example/demo/
│   │   └── resources/
│   │       ├── application.properties
│   │       └── static/
│   │       └── templates/
│   └── test/
└── pom.xml

quizData.question: Which dependency did we add to our project?
quizData.explanation: We added **Spring Web** to handle HTTP requests and build REST APIs.
